notes.title: v1.0.5 is here!
notes.notes:
This version includes various bug fixes both minor and major. 

*Deliveries/Missions difficulity is lowered
*Pathfinding/Worker-navigation has been greatly improved

notes.title: Release notes
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the release of Hard Work.
As of today the game is available with a launch discount of 20% instead of the initially planned 15%. 
Have fun and feel free to leave feedback and/or address any bugs at the community discussions.
